name: AppVault
subtitle: AppVault and official IPA download tools
description: DLiPA is a separate third-party App Store IPA downloader. AppVault provides experimental data backups and does not extract installed IPA packages on iOS 27.0.1.

apps.name: AppVault
apps.subtitle: Back up selected IPAs and app data
apps.localizedDescription: Experimental app-data ZIP backup with bounded LaunchServices database discovery. Requires a usable signed App Group. Device behavior remains unverified. Installed IPA extraction on iOS 27.0.1 is unsupported.

versions.localizedDescription: Exclude protected container metadata from app-data backup; copy Documents and Library with an exclusions manifest. Physical-device retest remains pending.

apps.name: DLiPA
apps.subtitle: App Store IPA downloader
apps.localizedDescription: Official, unmodified DLiPA by AhmedBafkir. Download and share App Store apps as IPA files using your Apple Account; supports available older versions. This downloads packages from Apple, not the installed binary from your phone. Apple account authorization and version availability apply. Authentication and downloads on iOS 27.0.1 have not been tested by AppVault's maintainer.
